nodes.label: Research and Technology
nodes.rationale: Research is core gameplay, limited and specialized; it unlocks policy capabilities without activating them automatically.

nodes.label: Frontier
nodes.rationale: Persistent multiplayer colonization game where players govern through intentions, policies, and strategy rather than micro-management.

nodes.label: Autonomy and Execution
nodes.rationale: The colony observes state, derives priorities, creates and allocates work, executes it, and explains decisions and failures.

nodes.label: Combat
nodes.rationale: Combat uses prepared CombatEntity confrontations, physical approach, defense doctrine, bounded theft, recovery, and offline protection rules.

nodes.label: Sector Policies
nodes.rationale: Policies replace a free-form priority queue and create contextual priorities, demands, jobs, trade-offs, and observable consequences.

nodes.label: Real-Time 1:1 Clock
nodes.rationale: One in-game day lasts 24 real hours; actions have real duration and the colony continues operating offline.

nodes.label: Governance Explanation
nodes.rationale: Every relevant change or block should expose active intent, applied rule, observed state, receiving system, result, and next player decision.

nodes.label: Colony
nodes.rationale: One colony per player is the political and operational unit; its small population is governed through derived priorities.

nodes.label: Health sequencing after the initial core loop
nodes.norm_label: health sequencing after the initial core loop

nodes.label: Individual Colonist
nodes.rationale: An individual agent with skills, needs, health, relationships, experience, loyalty, and history.

nodes.label: Health as basic support in the first cycle
nodes.norm_label: health as basic support in the first cycle

nodes.label: Research queue and permanent knowledge
nodes.rationale: Research is essential to the playable core; v1 has one queue and one active research per colony, and acquired knowledge remains permanent without direct transfer by trade or contracts.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.rationale: A persistent rule describing permitted behavior and derived priorities; it is distinct from a one-off goal or order.

nodes.label: Research specialization and limited capacity
nodes.rationale: Limited research capacity forces competition among medicine, education, military, production, energy, and logistics; specialization creates dependencies and trade.

nodes.label: Limited Research Capacity and Specialization Trade-off
nodes.norm_label: limited research capacity and specialization trade-off

nodes.label: No Direct Research Transfer Through Contracts or Trade
nodes.norm_label: no direct research transfer through contracts or trade

nodes.label: Single Research Queue and One Active Research
nodes.norm_label: single research queue and one active research

nodes.label: Real-time game clock and bounded action durations
nodes.norm_label: real-time game clock and bounded action durations
nodes.rationale: The clock is continuous and 1:1 with real time, but central actions use hours or game-days rather than requiring weeks of real time; a construction may take about five in-game hours.

nodes.label: Research as Policy Expansion and Specialization
